name: Warmonger
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.
Target you and all creatures within a 20-ft. burst, centered on you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

All creatures within 20 feet of you – friend and foe alike – fall into a barbaric rage. For the spell’s duration, all affected creatures gain +4 bonuses to Strength and Constitution and a +2 morale bonus to Will saves, but also suffer a -2 penalty to AC.
